Binary x0, ordinary positive rational lambda and0<epsilon<1/8. Output positive rational nominal coefficients<=1,0<delta<=1/2 andT>0. For EVERY unknown FIXED time-independent independent relative coefficient error<=delta, require nonexplosion/positive recurrence/unique mu, whole stationary and transient TV to actual-class conditional Poisson pi<=epsilon, and EACH absolute coordinate first-mean error<=epsilon. quoted_fields.failure: Complete positive results have EXACT finite-class, rank-one or specified-two-species scope; general interacting higher-rank infinite classes remain OPEN. Conditional transfer assumes, rather than proves generally, perturbed nonexplosion/positive recurrence/unique stationary law and sufficient uniform polynomial moments, including nominal evolution started from perturbed stationary laws. Literature/project citation snippets do not supply missing quantitative recurrence or robustness premises. No novelty, physical device advantage or independent validation is claimed; all held/unread sources and transfer limits persist. Existing N1782 conservative gap/equilibrium results and the new nonconservative nominal spatial-mixing theorem are not open questions. The nominal invariant-tail lemma does not prove independent-error recurrence/moments. The cycle limit requires sufficiently high uniform perturbed stationary moments; perturbed transient moments remain unpaid generally. The numerical-range example is the SAME network already robustly realized by D123, so it is a proof-route obstruction, not a universal negative.
